result.note: A draft EU trade-environment measure affecting India. Testing the stated reason and the start date, avoiding the ambiguous direction of trade.

questions.prompt: In September 2026, the European Commission proposed excluding India from EU metal-scrap imports. Consider the following statements about the proposal:
items: The Commission cited insufficient pollution controls as the reason for the exclusion.
The exclusion would take effect as soon as the consultation closes in October 2026.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: The proposal cites insufficient pollution controls, but the exclusion would apply from May 2027, not October 2026. October 16 is only the deadline for consultation on the draft.
questions.source: The European Commission proposed excluding India from EU metal-scrap imports from May 2027, citing insufficient pollution controls, with the draft open to consultation until October 16.
